periods.time: Ten minutes before the Hagun-Akatsuki clash

name.zh: 艾莉丝坦白并反转缝影奇袭
name.en: Alice confesses and reverses the Shadow Bind ambush

periods.location: Hagun return bus and Hagun campus battlefield
periods.summary: On the bus back to Hagun, Alice pins the passengers' shadows and reveals his true role as a Rebellion assassin planted to immobilize Hagun from behind. He then asks them to help him ruin Akatsuki's plan because he cannot destroy Shizuku's hopes. Ikki decides to trust him. At the battlefield, Alice appears to use Shadow Bind on all Akatsuki members instead of Hagun, allowing Hagun to cut them down—until the victory is revealed as a trap.
periods.cause: Alice chooses Shizuku's wish and Hagun's Seven Stars dream over his Akatsuki assignment.
periods.outcome: Hagun briefly gains what seems to be a decisive surprise, but Akatsuki has foreseen the betrayal.
periods.significance: Alice's moral turning point; also sets up Amane's foresight as the reason Akatsuki survives.
